svg.title: Container diagram: Wishem
svg.desc: Wishem has eleven containers. The workbench process runs the host-nodejs package and uses the core package. The host-nodejs and core packages build on the hub package, and so does the page. The page and the workbench process build on the renderer-react package. The clock package builds on the hub package. The PixiJS process serves the link with the host-nodejs package and builds on the clock and core packages. The PixiJS page builds on the renderer-pixi, hub, and clock packages. The PixiJS page gets page code over HTTP and connects to the hub over a WebSocket link through the PixiJS process. The workbench process reads, watches, and writes the model folder. The page gets page code over HTTP and connects to the hub over a WebSocket link through the process. The designer starts the two processes, edits the model folder, and looks at the two pages.
